products.name: Ceremonial matcha, 30 g
products.short: Our house matcha from Uji: one blend, first harvest, stone-milled. Fifteen bowls of usucha.
products.description:
The same matcha we whisk at the counter. Keep the tin closed and cool, and finish it within a month of opening: matcha is at its best fresh.

For usucha: 2 g of matcha, 70 ml of water at 70 °C, fifteen seconds of whisking.

products.name: Hojicha powder, 50 g
products.short: Roasted green tea, milled fine for lattes. Warm and nutty; an evening cup.
products.description: Whisk 3 g into 60 ml of hot water, then top with warm milk.

products.name: Chasen, bamboo whisk
products.short: Cut from a single piece of bamboo, about a hundred tines. The one tool matcha cannot do without.
products.description: Soak the tines in warm water for a minute before the first use. Rinse with water only, never soap, and let it dry on a stand.

products.name: Chashaku, bamboo scoop
products.short: Two scoops are about two grams: one bowl of usucha.
products.description: Wipe with a dry cloth after use. Bamboo does not like water.

products.name: Whisk stand
products.short: A ceramic stand that keeps the chasen's shape while it dries.
products.description: Set the rinsed whisk on the stand, tines down. It dries evenly and keeps its curve for months longer.

products.name: Chawan, black
products.short: A wide stoneware bowl with room for the whisk, made to be held in both hands.
products.description: About 12 cm across. Rinse by hand; each bowl differs a little in glaze and shape.

products.name: First bowl set
products.short: A tin of our matcha, a chasen, a chashaku and a black chawan: everything for the first bowl at home.
products.description: The four things in this set cost 11,200 RSD bought one by one.

products.name: Tote bag
products.short: Heavy undyed cotton with the Machiko bowl printed in green.
products.description: 38 × 42 cm with long handles. Wash cold.

products.name: T-shirt まちこ

products.description: A straight, roomy cut. Wash at 30 °C, inside out.

products.name: Tenugui cloth

products.description: The cut ends are left unhemmed, as tenugui always are; they fray a little and then stop.

products.name: Enamel pin

products.description: With a rubber clutch on the back.
